in_hebrew.name: חלד
in_hebrew.long_meaning: One who holds, possesses, or nurtures like a young goat or calf. This could represent a shepherd or someone who takes care of the flock.

in_greek.name: Ἕλδος
in_greek.long_meaning: A name derived from the Greek verb 'Ἕλδω', which means 'to hold, possess, grasp, keep'. This name could represent someone who is a guardian, protector, or one who holds power or authority.
